response.original_title: Festa al teatro delle Acque nei giardini di Villa Torlonia a Frascati
response.overview: A surviving fragment of a garden celebration at the Teatro delle Acque of Villa Torlonia in Frascati, with young women performing a historical dance and formally dressed guests gathering for an outdoor party.
